trace.name: trace
preview_rows: Trace of a Point wrt a Triangle
The trace of a point P is the intersection of two lines:
The first line goes through P and one of the vertices, say A.
The second line is the side of the triangle opposite to A, BC.
There are three trace points, or traces: TrA, TrB and TrC.

HarmMean.name: HarmMean
preview_rows: The harmonic mean of two numbers is H(x,y) = 2/((1/x) + (1/y))
How it's related to the harmonic conjugates:
Let x be the distance between A and C, and let y be the distance between A and D
Then the diameter of the circle AB is the harmonic mean of distances x and y
In general, the harmonic mean of n numbers is H = n/( (1/x1) + (1/x2) + … ( (1/xn) )
H is always between xMIN and xMAX:  xMIN ≤ H ≤ xMAX
Parallel resistors R1, R2, … , Rn have equivalent resistance of H/n
Parallel inductors L1, L2, … , Ln have equivalent inductance of LEQ = H/n
